verdict.rationale: Sprinto has a docs page titled "Selecting an Audit Partner" under its Audits section. It also documents working with your auditor in-platform. Together these suggest you can choose an auditor through the product, but the evidence is only a page title and a one-line claim. Missing for 10: evidence of a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm, details of how booking works, published audit timeline expectations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
